glosses: orphanage (a residential institution for the care and protection of orphans)

examples.text: Tom não queria voltar para o orfanato.
examples.en: Tom didn't want to go back to the orphanage.

examples.text: Foi muito divertido cantar com as crianças no orfanato.
examples.en: It was a lot of fun singing with the kids at the orphanage.
Tom grew up in an orphanage.

examples.text: Ele entregou o pacote no orfanato.
examples.en: He delivered the package to the orphanage.
